types.description: Harmony XB4 body/fixing collar with one normally open contact, screw clamp terminals

modelingNotes: Source spelling ZB4-BZ101 is retained. Historical manufacturer catalog 36068-FR.indd version 6.1 spells ZB4 BZ101; current sheet spells ZB4BZ101. Presentation-punctuation equivalence is an explicit inference documented in research.md.
Includes one contact and body/fixing collar. Operator head and any additional contact or light blocks are outside this order's modeled scope.

Model keys 3 and 4 follow the readable physical markings on the exact manufacturer datasheet photograph. Its separate ISO-description field says 13-14; this discrepancy is preserved without inventing extra terminals or claiming a formal numeric alias map.
NO function describes normal contact state without creating net continuity. No fixed links; passive connections are application-dependent. No operator latching or spring-return behavior is asserted.
Conditional AC-15 and DC-13 ratings are recorded in research.md; no scalar nominal voltage, switching-current limit or AC-only metadata is assigned.

The exact catalog selection row and corresponding NO symbol were visually reviewed on October 2021 catalog PDF page 78, printed page 76. Contact-no represents the included contact without asserting a head type.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both physical contact clamps 3 and 4 are represented. Datasheet ISO field 13-14 is recorded separately, not treated as extra endpoints. Metal collar attachment/bonding remains unresolved; no PE terminal or installed panel bond is inferred.
